title: Unfolded checks
description: Formules/unfold.json -- what Woodcore last wrote of each member check printed unfolded as a domain of the «Formules» tab (calc/domains/unfold.py; spec docs/requirements/completed/2026-10-15-calculs-deplies-balises-figures-natives.md, REQ-007, ARCH-RISK-205). Woodcore's own file, beside the domains it describes so that an archive and a copy of the project carry it, written whole with sorted keys and no date, never edited by hand. For each domain: the check it was written from, the form (`gen`) it was written for, and, for each of its lines -- a command by its kind and key or id, a line of text the writer owns by its label -- the digest (sync.digest: 16 hex digits of SHA-256, line endings LF) of the line as Woodcore last wrote or took it: the base a line of the file and a line of a new writing are each compared with, so that a change made in VS Code is told from a change of the data.

schema_version.description: 1.0 -- a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

domains.description: One entry per unfolded domain, keyed by its id, which is its check's (D-14).

check.description: The id of the record the domain is written from: a member check (sources/checks/<id>.json, in Timber-checks/unfold.json), a steel check (sources/steel/<id>.json, in Steel-checks/unfold.json, spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte, REQ-017) -- one base per kind of domain, beside its files.

gen.description: The form the domain was written for, as its #var-domain(gen:) writes it.

lines.description: {line id: [own, seen]}: `var:<key>`, `eq:<key>`, `verify:<id>`, `label:<label>` -- `own` the digest of the file's line as Woodcore last wrote or took it, `seen` that of the writing's line then; the two differ where a line is kept as the engineer wrote it (REQ-009, REQ-010).
